title: 男装姿势示意图 · 大码 / 标码

spec.note: 同一模特、同一套服装（米白衬衫 + 炭灰直筒裤 + 白鞋）只变姿势，便于横向对比；图片来源为生成示意，非实际拍摄。

poses.name: 正面微侧
poses.desc: 身体正对镜头，肩线向左转约 15°，胯部仍正对镜头；重心压在后腿，前膝放松，双臂自然垂于体侧。
poses.actionEn: Standing facing the camera with shoulders turned about fifteen degrees, hips square, weight on the back leg, arms hanging relaxed.

poses.name: 行走跨步
poses.desc: 一前一后迈步，前脚脚跟先着地、后脚跟离地；双臂与腿部反向摆动，身体略向前送。
poses.actionEn: Caught mid-stride with the front heel landing and the back heel lifted, arms swinging in opposition to the legs.

poses.name: 单手插袋
poses.desc: 一只手插进前袋、拇指留在袋口外，另一只手自然下垂；重心偏向一侧，胯部轻微偏移。
poses.actionEn: One hand slipped into the front pocket with the thumb out, the other arm hanging relaxed, weight shifted onto one leg.

poses.name: 双手抱臂
poses.desc: 小臂在胸前中段交叉，双手分别扶在另一侧上臂；肩部下沉放松不耸起，下巴略收。
poses.actionEn: Forearms crossed at mid-chest with each hand tucked under the opposite upper arm, shoulders relaxed and level.

poses.name: 侧身站立
poses.desc: 身体与镜头呈 90° 侧向，近侧肩朝前，头部转回看向镜头；近侧手臂沿胯自然下垂。
poses.actionEn: Body turned ninety degrees to the side while the head turns back to the camera, near arm hanging along the hip.

poses.name: 背身站立
poses.desc: 背对镜头，肩胛自然下沉，双臂垂放且与身体留出缝隙；头部略向一侧转，露出少量下颌线。
poses.actionEn: Back fully to the camera, shoulder blades settled, arms hanging with a small gap from the body, head turned slightly.

poses.name: 正面静态展示
poses.desc: 双脚与肩同宽平踏地面，双臂略微离开身体、掌心朝后，完整展示衣服廓形与肩线。
poses.actionEn: Standing square with feet shoulder-width, arms held slightly away from the body with palms back to show the full silhouette.

poses.name: 回眸半侧身
poses.desc: 背身约 3/4，躯干扭转 45° 让前襟进入画面，头部越过一侧肩膀回望镜头。
poses.actionEn: Back three quarters to the camera, torso twisted forty-five degrees so the front panel shows, head turned over one shoulder.

poses.name: 倚墙站立
poses.desc: 一侧肩膀轻靠墙面，身体斜向镜头；双脚脚踝交叉，一手拇指勾住袋口，姿态松弛。
poses.actionEn: One shoulder leaning lightly against a wall, ankles crossed, one thumb hooked into a pocket, relaxed posture.

poses.name: 自然坐姿
poses.desc: 坐在台沿前缘，双膝分开，双脚平踏地面；小臂搭在大腿上，背部挺直但不僵。
poses.actionEn: Seated on the front edge of a low ledge, knees apart, feet flat, forearms resting on the thighs, back fairly straight.

poses.name: 单膝蹲姿
poses.desc: 单膝下蹲接近地面，另一脚在前平踏；前臂横搭在前膝上，胸部打开、下巴抬起。
poses.actionEn: One knee lowered toward the floor, the other foot planted flat in front, forearm across the front knee, chest open.

poses.name: 矮凳前倾
poses.desc: 坐在矮凳上，从髋部前倾，小臂搭在膝上、双手轻扣；背部拉长不弓，抬头看镜头。
poses.actionEn: Sitting on a low stool, leaning forward from the hips with forearms on the knees, back long, head lifted to the lens.

poses.name: 迈步上台阶
poses.desc: 一只脚踏上台阶，另一腿在后、后跟抬起；重心前移，手臂一前一后摆动，躯干略前倾。
poses.actionEn: One foot placed on a low step, the trailing heel lifted, weight travelling forward, arms swinging in opposition.

poses.name: 整理袖口
poses.desc: 低头用一只手整理另一侧袖口，被整理的小臂抬至身前、肘部内收；注意力在袖口而非镜头。
poses.actionEn: Head tipped down while one hand adjusts the opposite cuff, the forearm raised across the body, elbow tucked in.

poses.name: 手扶衣领
poses.desc: 一只手抬到颈侧扶住领口边缘，似在校正领型；另一手垂放，下巴略抬。
poses.actionEn: One hand raised to grip the collar edge near the neck, the other arm relaxed, chin slightly lifted.

poses.name: 拉链半开
poses.desc: 一只手捏住拉链头停在胸口位置，门襟半开露出一段内搭；另一手扶在胯侧，视线略向下。
poses.actionEn: One hand holding the zipper slider at mid-chest so the placket sits half open, the other hand at the hip, gaze slightly down.

poses.name: 双手插兜
poses.desc: 双手同时插入前袋、拇指留在袋口外，肘部微微外张；肩部放松略向后，姿态随性。
poses.actionEn: Both hands pushed into the front pockets with thumbs outside, elbows bowing slightly outward, shoulders relaxed.

poses.name: 转身动态
poses.desc: 半转身被定格：胯部已转开、肩头仍在摆动，衣摆甩起；一臂后拖、一臂横过身前保持平衡。
poses.actionEn: Caught halfway through a turn, hips rotated away while shoulders still swing, hem lifting, one arm trailing for balance.
